parsed.rationale: I agree it's RBBB: V1–V2 show an rSR′/M-shaped complex with a dominant late R′, leads I and V6 have broad slurred S waves, and the ST depression and T inversion in V1–V3 are the usual secondary changes, with no ST elevation meeting STEMI criteria in any two contiguous leads.
